content:
**Built the lane collector shell and memory:collect (#887, slice B): plumbing only, one local ref, secret scanned before hash-object, CAS on update-ref**

**What**: Added brain/scripts/memory/lane/collect.mjs (collectLane: enumerates every worktree of the clone via worktree list --porcelain, lists untracked .memory/records/*.jsonl with ls-files --others -uall, filters against origin/main via one ls-tree, scans each candidate with scanTextForSecrets BEFORE hash-object -w --stdin --path, builds the tree in a temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE from the parent tree, commit-tree, update-ref refs/heads/memory/<host>-<date> with a compare-and-swap old value; same-day re-run appends onto the ref tip; nothing new leaves the ref untouched with commit null), the collect op in memory/cli.mjs (dispatched before backend selection, --json {ref, commit, collected, skipped, duplicates, baseFetched}), eight i18n keys in en and es, package.json memory:collect, an integration test on a real temporary repo with two worktrees (no-mutation invariant via before/after git status --porcelain and HEAD; the secret blob proven absent via cat-file -e; lost CAS never retried) and a CLI test. removeTempTree moved to brain/scripts/lib/tmp-tree.mjs with __fixtures__ re-exporting (design D8).

**Why**: Wave 3 slice 3.1a of #864 under ADR-0034 L4/C2/D4; PR B of the #887 split, stacked on the planner (#897, PR #898).

**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/lane/collect.mjs, collect.integration.test.mjs, memory/cli.mjs, cli.collect.test.mjs, brain/scripts/i18n/{en,es}.mjs, brain/scripts/lib/tmp-tree.mjs, package.json; openspec/changes/issue-887-lane-collector/**; epic tasks 1.1 and 3.1a ticked.

**Learned**: a fresh cold review found collected counting group winners instead of new blobs on a same-day re-run (candidates were filtered against origin/main only, not the lane tip): fixed by counting the tree delta. update-ref <ref> <new> '' is the correct must-not-exist form on git 2.53. Only lock/old-value stderr shapes are reported as raced; anything else is a plain failure. The three-dot dependency for #889's lane-paths was posted on the ticket.
